
DELETE-DIAGRAM
Delete a diagram from foundation.json

USAGE
  fspec delete-diagram <section> <title>

ARGUMENTS
  <section> (required)
    Section name in foundation.json
  <title> (required)
    Diagram title to delete

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Delete specific diagram
  $ fspec delete-diagram "Architecture Diagrams" "Command Flow"
  ✓ Deleted diagram from foundation.json

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-diagram
  fspec show-foundation
  fspec update-foundation
